name: San Mateo County Library Open Sewing Programs
description: Free open sewing and mending programs at libraries in Foster City, Half Moon Bay, Millbrae, Redwood City, San Mateo, and South San Francisco
fullDescription: Public libraries across San Mateo County offer free open sewing and mending programs, where you can use library sewing machines, repair clothing, and share sewing skills with neighbors. Programs are open to everyone, not just city residents.
whatTheyOffer:
- Free sewing and mending programs
- Library sewing machines available
- Foster City and Half Moon Bay (Open Sewing)
- Millbrae and Redwood City (Open Sewing; embroidery machine in Redwood City)
- San Mateo (Afternoon Sewing) and South San Francisco (Mending Hour)
- Open to everyone
howToGetIt:
1. Check the schedule on the County Sustainability Department's Fixit Clinics page
2. Click the program link for your library for current dates
3. Bring items needing repair
4. Attend during program hours
5. Mend and sew alongside neighbors
6. Learn sewing skills
keywords: sewing, mending, library, free, Foster City, Half Moon Bay, Millbrae, Redwood City, San Mateo
